candidate_microdirections.name: adaptive_credit_topology_null
candidate_microdirections.question: Do path/broadcast credit policies manufacture stable recurrence or topology that vanishes under frozen or shuffled learning?
candidate_microdirections.test: Compare frozen learning, truthful path credit, broadcast credit, and shuffled credit while holding perturbation and update budget fixed.

candidate_microdirections.name: volatility_conditioned_reentry_estimand
candidate_microdirections.question: Do emergence readouts misclassify harmful fixed recurrence as stable integration across volatility regimes?
candidate_microdirections.test: Compare fixed, adaptive, no, and shuffled re-entry over matched volatility regimes and compute causal/cost readouts.

candidate_microdirections.name: timescale_aliasing_of_directed_flow
candidate_microdirections.question: Can sampling cadence and lag choice create apparent macro autonomy or directed flow in recurrent multi-timescale traces?
candidate_microdirections.test: Replay the same process at multiple observation cadences and lag embeddings with common-driver controls.

candidate_microdirections.name: adaptive_compensation_confounds_lesion_rescue
candidate_microdirections.question: Can continued online learning during a lesion reroute function so delayed lesion loss and post-adaptation rescue falsely imply that an originally causal pathway was unnecessary or that rescue is harmful?
candidate_microdirections.test: Fork from one pre-intervention snapshot: frozen-learning lesion, truthful-learning lesion, shuffled-credit lesion, mechanism-only rescue, full learner-state rollback rescue, and intermittent perturbation schedules.

candidate_microdirections.name: estimator_selection_leakage
candidate_microdirections.question: Does selecting an emergence estimator or coarse-graining on the same episodes inflate apparent emergence?
candidate_microdirections.test: Compare same-data selection to nested held-out estimator/coarse-graining selection under fixed candidate budgets.
